caseName: Cardinal Sporting Goods Co., Inc. v. Eagleton, Attorney General of Missouri
caseNameFull: CARDINAL SPORTING GOODS CO., INC., Et Al. v. EAGLETON, ATTORNEY GENERAL OF MISSOURI, Et Al.
attorneys: Norman Diamond for appellants., Samuel H. Liberman for appellees.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

It appearing from .the motion to dismiss that this case is moot, the judgment of the United States District Court for the Eastern District of Missouri is vacated and the case is remanded with directions to dismiss the complaint as moot.
